pages.title: Structures
pages.text: This pack has a lot of structure mods. Together they add villages, ruins, dungeons, forts and wrecks, many of them stuffed with loot. This is the guide to which mod adds what.

pages.title: How Far Apart
pages.text: Structures are spread out so each find counts. The surface has about twice as many as vanilla, shared evenly by kind: a mod with ten kinds of building turns up five times as often as one with two. The next of the same kind can be kilometres away.

Below ground and under the sea there are about three times as many as vanilla; mineshafts keep their own rate. The sky holds about as many as vanilla's surface. Boss lairs and the dungeons with the best loot stay rarer than everyday builds.
Left as common as their mods make them, because they are part of the land: the Ice Maze's ice arches, the Abyssal Chasm, the Toxic Caves' acid pits, and wild cherry trees and berry bushes.

[#](2E5AAC)[Structure Packs](entry://exploration/structure_packs)[#](): Towns and Towers, Dungeons and Taverns, When Dungeons Arise and the YUNG's mods.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Create Structures](entry://exploration/create_structures)[#](): buildings with trains, airships, cranes and oil rigs.\
\
[#](2E5AAC)[Lootr](entry://exploration/lootr)[#](): why a looted chest still has loot for you.

Structures in the sky are in [#](2E5AAC)[Destinations](entry://flight/destinations)[#](). Structures in the sea are in [#](2E5AAC)[Underwater Places](entry://ocean/underwater_places)[#](). Bosses defend many of them: [#](2E5AAC)[Bosses](entry://exploration/bosses)[#]().
